name: TransADF
runtimeDependencies: AmigaOS 2.0 or later and a compatible block device, normally trackdisk.device for floppy operations
notes: The full standard executable links zlib statically and matches the Aminet member. The alternate RT and Lite builds do not ship in BCWB.
Directory Opus invokes TransADF to write images. Its configuration is owned by the Directory Opus package. BCWB ships the English guide and no command icon or saved settings.
